title: FLA import: characterPosition (superscript/subscript) skipped in readTextRunFields
description: In packages/core/src/fla/flash8-binary.ts, readTextRunFields() skips the characterPosition byte (superscript/subscript). Around the text style fields, there should be a u8 for characterPosition (0=normal, 1=superscript, 2=subscript). Decode it and add to Fla8TextRun. Forward through flash8-import.ts to the TextFormat model (if TextFormat has a corresponding field, otherwise add one). In SWF encoding (packages/swf/src/text.ts), DefineEditText does not have a superscript field — this is typically stored in HTML text with <sup>/<sub> tags. For now, just capture it in the model.
